title: Does Speech Therapy focus only on spoken languages?
metaTitle: Speech Therapy and Various Communication Forms | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Speech Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network supports various communication forms, not just spoken language - paving the way for each child's unique communication journey.
html: Not at all! Speech Therapy, especially at Pinnacle Blooms Network, is about far more than just spoken languages. We understand communication is not one-size-fits-all. Our dedicated therapists are skilled in harnessing each child's unique capabilities, which can include spoken language, sign language, or utilizing communication devices, depending on what most suits the child.
